content_of_post_to_answer: Is holding anger worse for your health than venting it?
answer: The real health difference is not between holding anger and venting it; it is between processing anger and discharging it. Suppressing anger can keep the body in a state of stress, but uncontrolled venting can reinforce the same anger pathways and damage relationships. A useful distinction is expression versus release: expression tries to understand what the anger is signaling, while release simply transfers the pain outward. Anger becomes harmful when it is neither understood nor resolved.
